name: modus-api
description: Modus Express backend — MVC architecture with MongoDB Atlas

scripts.test: node test_phase2_auth.js && node test_phase3_songs.js && node test_phase4_playlists.js && node test_phase5_admin.js && node test_phase6_frontend_integration.js
scripts.seed: node -e "require('./config/db').connectDB().then(async () => { const fs=require('fs'); const Song=require('./models/Song'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../data/music_features.json')); for(const s of data.songs) { delete s.id; await Song.upsert(s); } console.log('Database seeded with', data.songs.length, 'songs'); process.exit(0); });"
